story.title: Android May Soon Restrict On-Device ADB

draft:
I've been following the developments on Android's potential restriction of on-device ADB. 
This change would likely impact developers who rely on ADB for testing and debugging. 
Key implications include limited access to device features and potential workarounds using USB debugging. 
Will this restriction hinder or help Android development overall?
